page.notes: The gutter numbers 10 to 60 are line counts; their exact position is approximate, as they do not align cleanly with the text lines. The entry marks "*" and "+" are printed symbols at line starts. Italic author names are read from the scan. Several abbreviations and proper names in the right-hand list are uncertain, notably "Meneciate", "mefoteta", "Spheru" and "propinationes", and the dense list may contain misreadings. The "Proba" catchword is read from the lower right corner. The left page shows "144" and the right page has no visible number.
